description:
A false-colour satellite map displays land cover classifications delineated by yellow polygonal boundaries, likely depicting an area within the Dalarna region of Sweden. The map features three primary CORINE Land Cover (CLC) classes:
*   **321 Natural Grasslands**: Located in the upper left (northwest) part of the image, appearing in light blue/cyan hues.
*   **311 Broad-leaved Forest**: Dominates the right (eastern) part of the image, distinguished by magenta/dark red colouring. A winding river, depicted in dark blue/black, flows through this forest area.
*   **322 Moors and Heathland**: Occupies the lower left (southwest) area, characterized by purple/darker magenta tones. A dark blue/black lake is prominently visible within this moorland region.
The image illustrates a distinct spatial pattern of these three land cover types, with clear boundaries separating the grassland, forest, and moorland ecosystems. No scale bar, compass, or specific date is visible.
